metrics.rank: Market-cap rank among available non-root rows; ties preserved
metrics.fdv: Current spot alpha/TAO price × nominal 21,000,000 alpha cap
metrics.ownerPerDay: Finalized alpha-out emission × owner slot / u64::MAX, floored per block, × 7200; daily-rate estimate, not actual trailing-day earnings or revenue
metrics.supply: Same-row pool alpha + outstanding alpha; not circulating or lifetime issuance
metrics.burns: All-wallet qualifying events >=100 alpha each over 30 days ending at separate reviewed archive cutoff; deduplicated and registration-filtered; not all-time
metrics.locks: Total current market-feed locked alpha; owner daily verified coldkey locked alpha; timestamps separate

performance: One existing coalesced owners request for both sections; module-level server burn aggregation; no visitor RPC or browser archive imports

validation.mobile: 375px visual check; no horizontal overflow; sources expandable
validation.pending: Mandatory release gate and READY live verification

reviewNotes: No changes to news editions, owner trading thresholds or burn archive semantics. All advanced metrics retained.
